Advance RNG stream

Source: R/rng.R
advance_rng_stream.Rd

Advances the RNG state by n steps and returns the new state.

Usage

advance_rng_stream(rng_stream, n = 1L)

Arguments

rng_stream

Integer vector RNG state

n

Number of steps to advance (default: 1)

Value

Advanced RNG state (integer vector)

Details

This function temporarily sets .Random.seed in .GlobalEnv to advance the stream, then returns the new state. It does NOT permanently modify the global .Random.seed (unless it did not exist before, in which case it is removed after use). The caller is responsible for applying the returned state if needed (e.g., via set_task_rng()).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
streams <- create_task_rng_streams(42, 10)
advanced <- advance_rng_stream(streams[[1]], n = 5)
} # }
